text.p: Arthur Andersen partner Martin Madden had been appointed receiver and manager of mobile telecommunications reseller Digicall Group Ltd by major creditor Vodaphone Group, the accountancy firm told Reuters on Monday.
Madden would issue a detailed statement later on Monday, the firm said.
An Arthur Andersen spokeswoman said its appointment by Vodaphone followed an attempt by Digicall to appoint voluntary administrators from Price Waterhouse.
Digicall gave Vodaphone security over its assets last Thursday, allowing the struggling company to access the final portion of a A$15 million guaranteed bank loan.
The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper said Vodaphone, the operator of Australia's third cellular network behind Telstra and Optus Communications, was owed about A$50 million.

Digicall was Vodaphone's largest reseller and a hot stock on the sharemarket until recent times, reaching a high of A$1.50 soon after it listed in July last year. The stock was suspended last Friday with a final trade of 12 cents.
